g.text: A dedicated support UI; AI proposes typed actions, while the host enforces every transition.
Goal: agree on the problem before diagnosing it.
Description or screenshot may already be enough.
If blocked, show one clarification inline.
Goal: collect only the evidence needed to recommend a safe next step.
Use existing context first. Ask only when an evidence gap blocks every safe route.
Tool errors are recoverable; collected evidence is preserved.
Close or reload → persist exact state → Paused
Reopen → restore exact substate · Discard requires an explicit user action
AI emits a typed intent + structured payload. The host validates the contract and guard,
then—and only then—changes the persisted state or starts side-effecting work.
Never mark resolved from agent confidence.
Only the user’s verification closes this route.
Guard: search completed—or the search failure is explicitly recorded.
A duplicate search—or recorded failure—comes first.
Publication approval covers the final sanitized text
Deep work moves into a normal Agent Host session
Start Agent Host with structured handoff
No PR preparation until the user says the fix works.
